common.module_off_hint: ⚠️ Module disabled: settings can still be edited, but features are inactive.
common.wrong_kind: ℹ️ This module is meant for servers of type: {kinds}.

auto.hint: Pick the roles given automatically. Remove a role from the selector to delete it.
auto.placeholder_BOT: Roles given to bots when they join…
auto.placeholder_VERIFIED: Roles given after the verification screen…
auto.delay_help: Applied to every role of the trigger. 24 h maximum.

menus.hint: Select a menu to edit it (roles, style, text, publishing to a channel) or create a new one.

reactions.hint: Link a reaction on an existing message to a role. The bot adds the reaction and manages the roles.
reactions.modal_link_help: Right-click the message → Copy Message Link.

notifs.hint: Notification roles members pick themselves. “Default roles” creates or links {count} ready-made roles.
notifs.defaults_done: Notification roles ready: {created} created, {linked} existing linked.
notifs.modal_key_help: Short identifier (e.g. streams). An existing key is updated.

fivem.title: 🎮 FiveM — {server}
fivem.hint: Select a server to manage its status, sync and roles.
fivem.empty: No FiveM server yet: add one with ➕, then install the rs_bridge resource.
fivem.install_value:
**API URL**: `{url}`
**GuildId**: `{guildId}` · **Server key**: `{key}`
**API key**: {apiKey}
Copy `fivem-resource/rs_bridge` into `resources/`, set `Config.BotUrl`, `Config.GuildId`, `Config.ServerKey` and `Config.ApiKey` in `config.lua`, then `ensure rs_bridge`.
fivem.server_hint: Status, channels, sync and roles of this server. Clearing a selector disables the option.
fivem.sync_syncBansToDiscord_desc: An in-game ban also bans the member on Discord.
fivem.sync_syncBansToGame_desc: A Discord ban is applied on the game server.
fivem.sync_syncKicks_desc: An in-game kick also kicks the member from Discord.
fivem.sync_syncNicknames_desc: The in-game name becomes the Discord nickname.
fivem.sync_requireDiscord_desc: Deny connection without a linked Discord account that is a server member.
fivem.sync_requireWhitelist_desc: Deny connection without an accepted whitelist application.
fivem.roles_hint: Linked role: given once the FiveM account is linked. In-game role: held while connected. Required role: needed to connect.
fivem.delete_confirm: Delete server **{name}** (`{key}`)? Connected resources will be disconnected.
fivem.modal_key_help: 2 to 64 characters: lowercase, digits, - or _. Goes into Config.ServerKey.
fivem.modal_host_help: Optional: server URL used to read players.json / info.json.
fivem.modal_api_key_help: Optional: otherwise the global FIVEM_API_KEY is used.
fivem.modal_api_key_edit_help: Empty = unchanged · “-” = remove the server-specific key.
fivem.modal_link_title: Link a member to a license
fivem.groups_hint:
Map Discord roles to in-game groups (ACE `group.<name>`). **Order matters**: the first group the member holds is their primary group (👑).
Applied on join and as soon as a role changes on Discord (≈ 10 s). In game: `add_principal` / `remove_principal`, `rs_bridge:groupsChanged` event and `exports.rs_bridge:GetGroups(source)`.
fivem.groups_footer: server.cfg: add_ace resource.rs_bridge command.add_principal allow (and command.remove_principal)
fivem.group_top_placeholder: Move to the top (highest priority group)…
fivem.modal_group_name_help: E.g. admin, mod, vip — lowercase, digits, _ - . (32 max)
fivem.modal_group_position_help: 1 = highest priority. Empty = last (or the role’s current place).
fivem.group_everyone: The @everyone role cannot be mapped to a group.
fivem.group_invalid: Invalid group “{value}”: 1 to 32 characters, lowercase, digits, `_`, `-` or `.`.

battleroyale.title: ⚔️ Battle Royale — {server}
battleroyale.hint: Seasons, Battle Pass and player administration tools.
battleroyale.no_season: No active season: create one with 🆕.
battleroyale.bp_hint: Tiers of the active season. ✏️ to edit them (one line per tier), 📦 to generate them.
battleroyale.tier_invalid: Invalid line {line}: “{content}” (format: tier | xp | free | premium).
battleroyale.tier_xp_order: Tier {tier}: required XP cannot be lower than the previous tier’s.
battleroyale.end_before_start: The end date must be after the start date.
battleroyale.modal_date_help: The new season becomes active and resets Battle Pass progress.
battleroyale.modal_tiers_help: tier | xp | free reward | premium reward — “-” = none.
battleroyale.modal_tiers_too_long: Current list is too long to be prefilled: enter the full list.
battleroyale.modal_generate_help: Tier n = n × XP. Existing rewards are kept.
battleroyale.modal_stat_value_help: Number ≥ 0 (yes / no for Battle Pass premium).
battleroyale.modal_stat_season_help: Season stats only — empty = current season.
battleroyale.modal_xp_help: Negative to remove. Also updates the Battle Pass.
battleroyale.modal_link_title: Link a player to their license
battleroyale.display_hint:
The bot posts **a single** leaderboard message (wins, kills, K/D — min. {min} matches) in the chosen channel and **updates it automatically** when stats change (at most once per minute, checked every 10 min). If it is deleted, it is posted again.
`/stat` channel: if set, `/stat` only answers there (elsewhere, a link to that channel).

whitelist.title: 📝 Whitelist — {server}
whitelist.hint: Members apply with `/whitelist apply`; staff handle applications in the review channel or with `/whitelist review`.
whitelist.accepted_placeholder: Role given to accepted applicants (empty = none)…
whitelist.dm_on: Applicants will receive the decision by DM.
whitelist.dm_off: Decisions are no longer sent by DM.
whitelist.questions_help: Label | short/paragraph | required/optional | placeholder — all empty = default questions.
whitelist.questions_default: Questions reset: the default questions will be asked.
whitelist.invalid_question: Invalid question {slot}: label required, {max} characters maximum.

school.title: 🎓 School RP — {server}
school.config_hint: Channel where applications are posted (`/school apply`) and default announcement channel (`/school announce`).
school.roles_hint: Discord roles given according to the school role (registration and accepted applications).
school.class_hint: Students pick their class when registering; open a class to set its role, channel or assign students.
school.class_view_hint: Class role and channel, head teacher, student assignment (profile required).
school.house_hint: Open a house to set its role or assign members. Points are still managed with `/school house points-add`.
school.house_view_hint: House role and member assignment (profile required).
school.club_hint: Members join clubs with `/school club join`. Open a club to set its role and leader.
school.club_view_hint: Role given to club members and club leader.

shop.title: 🛒 Shop — {server}
shop.hint: Select a product to edit it (price, stock, image, category, Tebex, visibility) or add a new one.
shop.empty: No product yet: add one with ➕ (create your categories first if needed).
shop.categories_hint: Categories filter the catalog (`/shop catalog`). Deleting a category leaves its products uncategorized.
shop.announce_hint: Pick the product and the channel, then publish: the announcement includes the “Order” button.
shop.modal_tebex_help: Links Tebex payments (webhook /api/shop/tebex) to this product. Empty = removed.
